story.title: BIG-bench 逻辑推理 · logical_deduction/seven_objects
story.text: On a shelf, there are seven books: a red book, a white book, a purple book, a black book, a gray book, an orange book, and a blue book

constraints.text: The red book is to the right of the white book
The gray book is to the left of the orange book
The gray book is to the right of the blue book
The red book is the second from the right
The black book is the fourth from the left
The orange book is to the left of the white book

question_prompt: 谁排在从左数第 4 位？
options: The red book is the fourth from the left.
The white book is the fourth from the left.
The purple book is the fourth from the left.
The black book is the fourth from the left.
The gray book is the fourth from the left.
The orange book is the fourth from the left.
The blue book is the fourth from the left.
hints: 把每条线索先翻译成“谁在谁前面/后面”。
把能确定的位置先固定下来，再继续推。
explanation: 来自 BIG-bench logical_deduction 第 24 例，由规则翻译器转换（Apache-2.0），未经人工改写。
